infobox.previous: All for the Show - Major Sponsor

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Superhuman is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, fighter. I won't waste time, let's get straight to it. We've got a very, very important sponsor. The guy's a bit of a nut, but he pours in serious money. I take his requests extremely seriously, and I don't just hire anyone for these things. Recently, he pitched me an unusual idea, and, well you get the picture, it needs to happen. You're perfect for the job."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate an enemy with a melee weapon while wearing a Ghoul mask

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Ref Rep +0.05
- 222,222 Roubles
- 99 GP coins
- 1× Lega Medal
- Unlocks Crash Axe in the Armory
- Unlocks achievement Legend of the Arena

sections.text:
